note.question: How does supplier-auditor collusion affect responsible sourcing?
note.overview: Although they enjoy low costs in sourcing from emerging economies, global brands also face serious brand and reputation risks from their suppliers’ noncompliance with environmental and labor standards. Such a supplier problem can be viewed as a process quality problem concerning how products are sourced and produced. Addressing this problem is a key component of many global companies’ responsible sourcing programs.
